CHIEF ACCEPTS SECOND-REVIEW BLOCK on exact 609e35f / cand-5WEZMFBGMXR0DYC2S1HTXCQX77. The two failures are independently load-bearing: (1) declaration extraction omits legal qualified-private and abstract/open declarations, so live public/internal APIs can return exit 0/no types; (2) a shared API change with an unchanged .js/.native-only downstream consumer emits an incomplete JVM command because only changed platform paths are preflighted and platform consumer roots are not searched.

Required same-path successor: one conservative declaration recognizer shared by BASE/HEAD that covers access modifiers plus abstract/open and existing forms; distinct qualified-private and abstract surviving-consumer courts. Search shared, .jvm, .js, and .native consumer roots. Given this bounded script still emits JVM tasks, fail exit 4 before any command whenever a matched downstream consumer is JS/Native-specific, and list exact consumer path/module; add symmetric JS and Native courts. Preserve all 46 existing assertions, deletion/rename behavior, docs and ONNX replays, and both prior .jvm mutation kills. Supersede 609 only after both reviewers re-read immutable successor bytes. No authorization.
